svg.title: NH Hiking Agent — hackathon-scoped project plan
svg.desc: Four-phase 10-day plan with daily tasks and explicit scope cuts for the White Mountains hiking agent hackathon

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Tell me more about dataset creation for the NH hiking agent')
g.text: Days 1–3 · the whole project depends on this

svg.text: Day 1 — structure & sourcing
· Define final trail list: all 48 NH 4K footers + popular non-summit Whites hikes (~80 total)
· Design Q&A schema: trail facts, difficulty, gear, logistics, weather hooks, beginner vs expert tone
Days 2–3 — generation & review
· Use a larger LLM (Claude, GPT-4o) to draft Q&A pairs per trail; seed with AMC, USFS, AllTrails data
· Human spot-check: distances, elevations, trailhead coords, safety-critical answers
· Format as JSONL for SFT; target 500–1 000 examples (enough to move the needle on a small model)

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Tell me more about fine-tuning for the hackathon timeline')
g.text: Days 3–6 · overlap with dataset tail; run training while reviewing data

svg.text: Model choice (pick one, commit early)
· Recommended: Llama 3.2 3B or Phi-4-mini — fast to fine-tune, deployable on HF Spaces free tier
· Use QLoRA via Unsloth or TRL — keeps GPU cost low, trains in hours not days
Training setup
· Run on Google Colab A100 or Kaggle (free) — no infra cost, shareable notebook as artifact
· 1–3 epochs on 500–1K examples trains in ~1–2 hours; leave time to iterate
· Eval: manually test 10–15 hike queries; check for hallucinated trail names, wrong distances
· Push final adapter + merged model to HuggingFace Hub before moving to Phase 3

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Tell me more about building the agent and Gradio UI')
g.text: Days 6–9 · wire the model into a working app

svg.text: MCP weather integration
· Call Mt. Washington Observatory MCP for summit conditions; surface in agent context
· Simple decision rule: if wind >60 mph or temp <20°F, flag exposed summits as advisory
Agent logic
· Gather context: experience level, target date, group, objective (beginner loop vs. 4K footer)
· Retrieve matching trails from a lightweight in-memory store (JSON, no vector DB needed)
· Fine-tuned model generates the recommendation narrative and safety notes
Gradio UI (keep it simple)
· gr.ChatInterface with a system prompt; sidebar inputs for date, experience, group size

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Tell me more about deploying to Hugging Face Spaces with Gradio')
g.text: Days 9–10 · ship it and document it

svg.text: · Push Gradio app.py + requirements.txt to a HF Space; set model ID and MCP key as Space secrets
· Use HF Spaces "persistent storage" or bundle the trail JSON directly — no database needed
· Write a short README/model card: what it does, scope (Whites only), known limitations
· Prepare 3 demo queries that showcase beginner path, expert 4K, and weather-aware response

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Why are these things cut from scope for the hackathon?')
g.text: Explicit scope cuts: no RLHF/DPO · no vector DB · no permit APIs · no mobile UI · no staleness pipeline
